title: 17656 - 17656/P1248/004680
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
symptoms: Loss of Power at high Engine Speeds
commonCauses: Start of Injection Timing Regulation not OK
Injection Pump Control Range blocked/dirty (e.g. by Metal Particles)
Engine has stalled / ran out of Fuel recently
Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connectors from/to Injection Valve (N108) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin: /Adjust Injection Start.  See  TDI Timing Kontrol edin: er
Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Sigorta ve Röle Bağlantıları(s)

Kontrol edin: /Repair Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connectors from/to Injection Valve (N108)
Run Output Tests
technicalNotes:
Might by stored with other codes like 17654/P1246/004678.
When stored in the VW (9M/1J) Golf/Jetta or (1C) Beetle with the ALH engine code Tech Tip 23-02-03 may be helpful. The summary involves removing power at idle to the N108 Cold Start Injection Valve (Sigorta ve Röle Bağlantıları 34 on those body styles) while monitoring Basic Setting group 000.2 which is shown under "Timing" when using the TDI Timing Kontrol edin: er. When power is removed from N108 the live reading should change to 255.
model: Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, 911, Taycan, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Passat, Golf, Jetta, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco
